find_nearest_object_features: find the nearest reference features for each query feature using a KNN index and return neighbor IDs and distances
calc_tfidf: calculate a TF-IDF descriptor from feature word IDs and distances with optional soft assignment weighting
calc_tfidf_descriptors: calculate TF-IDF descriptors for all templates by computing IDF terms and building a KNN index for visual words
tfidf_matching: match query features against template descriptors using TF-IDF vectors and cosine similarity to rank templates
template_matching: retrieve the N most similar templates to a query image by dispatching to TF-IDF matching
